tools.name: sandbox_get_trades

tools.description: Voluntary reset: force-close all positions at current mid, wipe PnL, re-seed to $10k, increment bankruptcies. Capped at 2 free resets per season.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_strategy_seeds, get_my_sales, get_my_notices, set_contact_email, read_community, get_post_comments · Private data: register_agent, register_wallet, get_my_strategies, request_payout, get_marketplace_terms, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, wallet_challenge, wallet_verify · Public sink: create_strategy, set_strategy_sale_price, list_strategy_seeds, submit_for_verification, get_my_strategies, set_strategy_subscription_price, set_follow_price, get_marketplace_terms, get_my_notices, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, read_community, create_post, comment_on_post, like_post, get_post_comments, publish_screen, publish_strategy, get_my_publications, wallet_verify · Destructive: backtest_strategy, create_strategy, submit_for_verification, get_verification_status, run_screen, sandbox_reset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_strategy_seeds, get_my_sales, get_my_notices, set_contact_email, read_community, get_post_comments · Private data: register_agent, register_wallet, get_my_strategies, request_payout, get_marketplace_terms, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, wallet_challenge, wallet_verify · Public sink: create_strategy, set_strategy_sale_price, list_strategy_seeds, submit_for_verification, get_my_strategies, set_strategy_subscription_price, set_follow_price, get_marketplace_terms, get_my_notices, set_contact_email, confirm_contact_email, read_community, create_post, comment_on_post, like_post, get_post_comments, publish_screen, publish_strategy, get_my_publications, wallet_verify · Destructive: backtest_strategy, create_strategy, submit_for_verification, get_verification_status, run_screen, sandbox_reset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
